content_zh:
他来了几分兴趣，坐在二八大杠上，静观事态的发展。
“哟，看不出小妞还挺倔的，既然如此，哥哥就不要你的钱了，你让哥哥亲你一口，哥哥就让你走。”
几名小混混中，一个穿着皮夹克，牙齿地包天的混混说道。
“这小妞真他娘的漂亮，就是不知道床上带不带劲，狗哥你把她带回去做狗嫂吧。”
“狗嫂倒是可以，就是不知道够骚不。”
几名小混混污言秽语说个不停，淫邪的目光在林柔身上扫来扫去。
林柔害怕得往后退了两步，双颊羞得通红，但还是硬着头皮道：“你们赶紧走开，不然我报警了。”
地包天冷笑一声，伸手朝着林柔抓了过去：“小妞，报警也没用，你就从了哥哥吧。”
见此，陈阳知道，该自己出手了。
嘎吱嘎吱嘎吱……
奇怪的摩擦声音传来，一辆满是锈迹的二八大杠骑进了胡同，椭圆的轮圈转动，陈阳在车上忽高忽低，充满了喜感。
在几名小混混和林柔的目光下，二八大杠停在了他们的旁边，陈阳猛地转头，指着地包天喊道：“放开那个女孩。”
“卧槽，哪里来的白痴，想学别人英雄救美？你也不照照镜子，就他`妈骑了这么辆破车，你居然敢学别人泡妞？”
地包天不屑的看着陈阳，眼神中满是凶戾之色，冷声道：“知不知道老子是谁，老子就是黑狼帮的疯狗，赶紧把钱放下，给老子滚蛋，不然扁得你退学。”
“怎么办？怎么办？他干嘛要过来，应该去找人帮忙才对。”
看着疯狗凶神恶煞的样子，林柔心里紧张不已，她转头看向陈阳，这位同学长得干瘦干瘦的，一看就不禁打，怎么会是人家几个人的对手。
“小子，把车也留下，滚蛋。”
疯狗身后一名黄毛上前，伸手按向陈阳二八大杠的把手，竟是贪婪得连这辆破车都不放过。
不过那黄毛还没碰到把手，陈阳反手一巴掌，啪一声，黄毛退了五六步，脸颊肿得跟个猪头一样，吐出一口血来，里面还带着两颗牙齿。
陈阳看向黄毛，脸上带着人畜无害的笑容：“你妈没教过你，没经过别人的允许，不能碰别人的东西吗？”

“卧槽尼玛，找死！”
“竟然敢打老子的人，弄死他。”
见一个骑破烂自行车的家伙如此嚣张，疯狗一帮人顿时就炸毛了，纷纷取出身上的折叠刀，朝陈阳围了上来。
林柔一看这阵仗，吓得身体一颤，却鼓起了勇气，上前张开手拦在陈阳的身前，喊道：“陈阳，快跑呀。”
说完，林柔对着疯狗一帮人吼道：“有本事你们冲我来，他只是路过的。”
看着林柔的纤瘦背影，陈阳目光中闪过意外和赞赏，他一把抓住林柔的胳膊往后一拉，林柔身体失控，朝着后面轻飘飘地退开。
她站稳后，只见疯狗几人一脸凶恶，手中的弹簧刀朝着陈阳身上划了过去。
“啊！”
林柔惊呼一声，双手捂住了眼睛，根本不敢看这血腥暴力的场面。
砰砰砰砰……
战斗的声音传来，林柔咬了咬牙，心头暗道：“陈阳挺身而出救我，我怎么能扔下他一个人。不行，我一定要帮他。”
鼓足了勇气，林柔闭眼朝前冲了上去，双手胡乱挥舞，却什么都没碰到，好像周围没人似的。
她心头疑惑，放下挥舞的粉拳，小心翼翼地睁开了眼睛。
当看清眼前的场景时，林柔顿时目瞪口呆。
疯狗一帮人躺在地上痛苦呻吟，一脸畏惧地看着陈阳；而陈阳则是骑在二八大杠上，连车都没有下。
看着陈阳高大的背影，这一瞬间，林柔觉得他好帅！
“他虽然有些嘴贫，但却是个好人，而且功夫还这么厉害。”
林柔只觉小心脏扑通扑通地猛跳，两团红晕浮上白嫩的脸颊，她心底啐了自己一口，摇了摇头，不再胡思乱想。
“疯狗是吧，来，让我看看你有多疯。”
陈阳朝疯狗招了招手，一脸笑意道。

疯狗几人吓得往后猛退，他们完全没料到，一个骑着破烂二八大杠的小子，竟然会是个高手。
“小子，你敢打我们黑狼帮的人，你给我等着，你们整个东安工大都要付出代价。”
疯狗留下一句狠话，跌跌撞撞地从地上爬起来，和几个手下飞也似的跑了。

content_en:
He became somewhat interested, sat on the 28th big bar, and watched the development of the situation.
"Oh, I don't see that this little girl is quite stubborn. In that case, my brother doesn't want your money anymore. If you let him kiss you, he will let you go."
Among the few gangsters, a gangster wearing a leather jacket and with teeth as big as the sky said.
"This girl is so damn pretty, but I don't know if she's good enough in bed. Brother Dog, please take her back to be your Dog Sister-in-law."
"The dog sister-in-law is okay, but I don't know if she's naughty enough."
Several gangsters kept talking dirty words, and their lustful eyes swept over Lin Rou.
Lin Rou was so frightened that she took two steps back, her cheeks turned red with embarrassment, but she still said bravely: "You guys go away quickly, or I will call the police."
Di Baotian sneered and stretched out his hand to grab Lin Rou: "Little girl, it's useless to call the police. Just obey my brother."
Seeing this, Chen Yang knew that it was time for him to take action.
Crunch, crunch, crunch...
A strange friction sound was heard, and a rusty 28-inch truck rode into the alley. The oval wheels were turning. Chen Yang was rising and falling on the car, full of joy.
Under the gazes of several gangsters and Lin Rou, Erba Dagang stopped next to them. Chen Yang suddenly turned his head, pointed at Di Baotian and shouted: "Let that girl go."
"What the hell, where do you think you're an idiot? You want to imitate other people's heroes and save beauties? You don't even look in the mirror. You're just riding such a crappy bike. How dare you imitate others in picking up girls?"
Di Baotian looked at Chen Yang with disdain, his eyes full of ferocity, and said coldly: "Do you know who I am? I am a mad dog from the Black Wolf Gang. Put down your money quickly and get out of here, or I will force you to drop out of school."
"What should I do? What should I do? Why did he come here? He should go find someone for help."
Seeing the ferocious look of the mad dog, Lin Rou felt very nervous. She turned to look at Chen Yang. This classmate looked so skinny that she couldn't help but hit him at first sight. How could he be the opponent of several of them?
"Boy, leave the car as well and get out."
A yellow man behind Mad Dog stepped forward and reached out to press the handle of Chen Yang's 28th big bar. He was so greedy that he wouldn't even let go of this broken car.
But before Huang Mao touched the handle, Chen Yang slapped him with his backhand, and Huang Mao took five or six steps back. His cheeks were swollen like a pig's head, and he spat out a mouthful of blood with two teeth in it.
Chen Yang looked at Huang Mao with a harmless smile on his face: "Didn't your mother teach you not to touch other people's things without their permission?"
"Damn it, you're looking for death!"
"You dare to hit my man and kill him."
Seeing how arrogant a guy riding a shabby bicycle was, Mad Dog and his gang immediately became furious. They all took out their folding knives and surrounded Chen Yang.
When Lin Rou saw the battle, she was so frightened that she trembled, but she mustered up the courage to step forward and stop Chen Yang with open hands, shouting: "Chen Yang, run quickly."
After saying that, Lin Rou yelled at Mad Dog and his gang: "Come to me if you can, he is just passing by."
Looking at Lin Rou's slender back, Chen Yang's eyes flashed with surprise and admiration. He grabbed Lin Rou's arm and pulled her back. Lin Rou lost control of her body and backed away lightly.
After she stood firm, she saw Mad Dog and the others with ferocious faces, and the switchblade in their hands slashed towards Chen Yang.
"Ah!"
Lin Rou exclaimed and covered her eyes with her hands, not daring to look at this bloody and violent scene.
Bang bang bang bang...
The sound of fighting came, and Lin Rou gritted her teeth and thought to herself: "Chen Yang stepped forward to save me, how could I leave him alone. No, I must help him."
Gathering up her courage, Lin Rou closed her eyes and rushed forward, waving her hands wildly but not touching anything, as if there was no one around.
Confused, she put down her waving pink fist and carefully opened her eyes.
When she saw the scene in front of her clearly, Lin Rou suddenlystunned.
The Mad Dog gang lay on the ground groaning in pain and looking at Chen Yang with fearful expressions; Chen Yang, on the other hand, was riding on the 28th big bar without even getting off the bike.
Looking at Chen Yang's tall back, at this moment, Lin Rou thought he was so handsome!
"Although he is a bit talkative, he is a good person, and his kung fu is so good."
Lin Rou felt her little heart beating violently, and two blushes appeared on her fair cheeks. She spit in her heart, shook her head, and stopped thinking.
"Mad dog, right? Come on, let me see how crazy you are."
Chen Yang waved to Mad Dog and said with a smile on his face.
Mad Dog and the others were so frightened that they backed away. They had no idea that a boy riding a shabby 28-meter bar would actually be a master.
"Boy, if you dare to hit someone from our Black Wolf Gang, just wait for me. Your entire Dong'an University of Technology will pay the price."
Mad Dog left a harsh word, stumbled up from the ground, and ran away with several of his men.
